# Equihash parameters, by height

ZClassic's proof-of-work parameters are **selected by height**, not
fixed for the life of the chain. Consensus reads them from
`EquihashUpgradeInfo` (`core/params/src/upgrades.c`) through
`chain_params_equihash_n/k` (`core/chainparams/src/chainparams.c`),
so the answer depends on which block you are asking about.

**Current mainnet is 192,7.** The launch parameters, 200,9, apply
only below the Bubbles activation height. Saying "ZClassic is
Equihash 200,9" without that qualifier describes a range of blocks
that ended years ago, and sizes a solution buffer wrongly.

Every number below is printed by linking the same translation units
the node validates blocks with. Nothing here is transcribed.

### mainnet

| From height | Upgrade | Equihash (N,K) | Solution bytes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Sprout | 200,9 | 1344 |
| 585318 | Bubbles | 192,7 | 400 |

### testnet

| From height | Upgrade | Equihash (N,K) | Solution bytes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Sprout | 200,9 | 1344 |
| 6350 | Bubbles | 192,7 | 400 |

### regtest

| From height | Upgrade | Equihash (N,K) | Solution bytes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Sprout | 48,5 | 36 |

A row appears only where the parameters change, so a network with
one row has used the same parameters since genesis.
